name: MLE-Agent
description: Command-line pair engineer for machine learning projects that plans, codes, debugs and can enter Kaggle competitions.
whatItDoes: Helps ML engineers and researchers start a project, build baselines, fix errors and summarise progress. A Kaggle mode can work through a competition with little supervision.
howItWorks: The CLI sets up a project workspace and runs a sequence of advisor, planner, coder and debugger roles, drawing on paper search and retrieval over the local codebase. It supports several hosted providers and local models.

requirements.name: LLM provider API key
requirements.description: OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini; not needed with Ollama
